The '''P-sz9.7 twin ion engine''' was a model of [[Twin ion engine/Legends|twin ion engine]] developed by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] for use in the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defender]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]]. The powerful engine made the Defender the fastest starfighter of its time.
